name: Sign-in and screen holds persist the hold protocol and release only when their dependency becomes ready
Ordinary holds retain deferral and deactivate old probes; Dale-step creation refuses deferral
A changed hold survives a probe that passed for the prior hold
Failed, unknown and hung probes retain the hold without notifying the parent; hung descendants stop
The existing watcher sweeps an idle home on cadence, keeps failures silent and emits one successful-release notification
An interrupted parent publication emits a recovery notification and reprobe finalizes exactly once
